name: Constrain
description: An experiment in which the text editor holds you to some poetic constraint. In this version, each line in a poem has to match the sentence structure of the first line. I'm curious about the experience of writing within an environment in which the constraint is chosen for you. I found this version to be... not as fun as writing by myself, but in this version you also have some control over the constraint, so perhaps an even more narrowly constrained version would be more of a gamelike challenge.
